reason: The source change only promotes the existing meshlet APIs from MESHOPTIMIZER_EXPERIMENTAL to MESHOPTIMIZER_API; it does not change their implementation, protocol, parameters, states, configurations, or input semantics. H0 already exercises every promoted function, including arbitrary untrusted decoding, supported vertex and triangle output widths, triangle-only and vertex-data round trips, and encoded-size bounds.
evidence: fuzzDecodeMeshlet invokes meshopt_decodeMeshletRaw with fuzz-derived vertex_count, triangle_count, data, and size.
fuzzDecodeMeshlet invokes meshopt_decodeMeshlet across vertex_size values 2 and 4 and triangle_size values 3 and 4.
fuzzRoundtripMeshlet and fuzzRoundtripMeshletV exercise meshopt_encodeMeshlet, meshopt_encodeMeshletBound, and meshopt_decodeMeshlet on valid encoded data.
The S0-to-S1 diff changes only the declaration macro and removes the 'Experimental:' labels for the four meshlet APIs.
recommended_action: No material fuzz-harness change is warranted for this source change; retain H0.
